description: Publishes messages to a Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic. Batches incoming messages and flushes when the batch size is reached or the timeout expires, whichever comes first.

inputs.name: Message
inputs.description: Message content to publish. Each change adds the new value to the internal buffer.

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: HTTP status code of the last publish request. 0 means no publish has been attempted yet.

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: True if the last publish request returned HTTP 200.

outputs.name: Buffered
outputs.description: Number of messages currently waiting in the buffer.

config.name: Service account key
config.description: Full JSON content of the GCP service account key file used for authentication.

config.name: Topic
config.description: Pub/Sub topic name to publish messages to.

config.name: Batch timeout
config.description: Maximum time in seconds to hold messages before flushing the buffer.

config.name: Batch size
config.description: Maximum number of messages in the buffer before an immediate flush is triggered.

state.name: Token expiry
state.description: Unix timestamp when the cached token expires.

state.name: Phase
state.description: Async operation tracker: 0 = idle, 1 = awaiting token, 2 = awaiting publish response.

state.name: Buffer
state.description: Accumulated message entries as comma-separated JSON fragments.

state.name: Buffer count
state.description: Number of messages currently in the buffer.

state.name: Pending payload
state.description: The full HTTP request body being published.
